scope: User-requested 15 separate conversations. Each owns only its numbered acceptance report directory; shared source/checklists remain coordinator-owned.

jobs.title: API contracts
jobs.task: Snapshot props, callbacks, models, defaults, subpaths and deprecations from public declarations/source; reconcile actual breaking changes with migration mappings. Reuse FA-01 export inventory; do not repeat it.

jobs.title: Architecture and dependency direction
jobs.task: Verify layer boundaries, internal root-barrel imports, one-way dependencies and source cycles. Use existing architecture/guards, and record exact unresolved cycles if any.

jobs.title: Owned interaction contracts
jobs.task: Audit React Aria confinement and owned public props; check for escaping collection/state/date/grid engine types or event payloads. Inspect declarations and source, reusing FA-01/02 and package evidence.

jobs.title: State and action semantics
jobs.task: Reconcile controlled/uncontrolled/default/null/disabled/read-only/loading/IDs and native click versus onPress contracts. Reuse existing focused behavior tests; examine duplicate-callback handling and identify actual exceptions.

jobs.title: Props and composition hooks
jobs.task: Audit owned variants/density/placement/dismissal/validation, accessible naming requirements, slots/parts/render callbacks/refs/classes/styles. Document actual public APIs and gaps without inventing consistency.

jobs.title: Compatibility names
jobs.task: Verify retained App/Class names, removed branded exports and replacements, Course naming for new learning APIs and breaking-change mappings. Preserve authorized Button rename and historical provenance.

jobs.title: Engine and host boundaries
jobs.task: Reconcile replaceable interaction architecture, observable tests, advanced extension points, host booking/account/backend ownership, dependency placement/version/deduplication and upgrade guidance. Do not promise free engine replacement.

jobs.title: Token generation and validation
jobs.task: Reconcile source schema, palette/semantic/component tiers, deterministic typed/CSS generation and CI reference/type/cycle/contrast checks. Reuse FA-04 foundation results; inspect actual generated source/validation evidence.

jobs.title: Typography and fonts
jobs.task: Reconcile typography roles including bodyAlt2, semantic HTML versus appearance, rem sizing/zoom/spacing/font substitution and Geist/system font ownership. Use existing native evidence where applicable; report actual gaps.

jobs.title: Density and theme scopes
jobs.task: Reconcile density defaults/compact compatibility, shared touch target policy, scoped roots/nested overrides/portals and light/dark/system SSR/hydration. Preserve bounded native evidence; avoid new broad engine matrices.

jobs.title: CSS distribution and guards
jobs.task: Reconcile CSS Modules build/output, stylesheet ordering, named layers/specificity/important caveats, optional resets/scoped normalization and lint/token rules. Reuse fresh FA-04 builds/package/foundation evidence.

jobs.title: Icons and activity symbols
jobs.task: Reconcile SVG source/mappings, owned props/refs, direct imports, optical/direction/accessibility behavior, activity fallback/options and catalog/bundle/notices obligations. Reuse FA-01 complete icon inventory; do not change legal notices.

jobs.title: Routing and account adapters
jobs.task: Reconcile native/custom router semantics, refs/attrs/modifiers/downloads/default prevention, routing integration ownership, account callback boundaries and async pending/error handling. Reuse relevant accepted browser/unit evidence.

jobs.title: Locale and translations
jobs.task: Reconcile locale/direction bridge, defaultMessage/keys/values/namespaces/English fallback, ICU/plurals/date/number formatting, long labels/RTL/pseudo-localized coverage. Distinguish DOM evidence from spoken AT.

jobs.title: Extraction and persisted contracts
jobs.task: Audit extraction manifest against current helpers/presets/models/editor nodes/plugins/fixtures/tests. Inventory public storage keys/schema/locale-date/error contracts. Preserve host application provenance read-only; do not access or modify another checkout.
